name: scoutwyze-compute-mcp
description: Ranks current RunPod GPU offers by price and freshness. Supports x402/USDC-on-Base payments.
long_description: Stateless MCP server wrapping ScoutWyze Compute's GPU-offer-ranking API. Two tools: scoutwyze_sample (free, anonymous preview) and scoutwyze_rank (ranks GPU offers for a workload, billed per successful match). Holds no private key and never signs or settles an x402 payment itself — an unauthenticated scoutwyze_rank call returns the real 402 payment challenge as tool content for a wallet-capable calling agent to settle.

tools.name: scoutwyze_sample
tools.description: Free, anonymous, rate-limited preview of a real ranked GPU offer. No arguments, never billed.

tools.name: scoutwyze_rank
tools.description: Ranks current RunPod GPU offers by price and freshness for a given workload. Billed per successful match.

api_key.title: ScoutWyze API Key
api_key.description: Optional prepaid Bearer key from POST /v1/signup + POST /v1/checkout-sessions. Omit to run unauthenticated — scoutwyze_rank will then return a real x402 payment challenge instead of ranked results.

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Overrides the default API base URL (https://scoutwyze-compute.fly.dev) — for local development only.
